description: GetKeyword + GetKeywordStats + GetRelatedKeywords: real Bing impression data for a query, its recent weekly history, and related queries — read straight from the Bing Webmaster API. FREE (no credits). Unlike derived/estimated keyword metrics, these numbers come from Bing's own search-impression logs. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_bing_keyword_research
